active_ledger.title: Brand Identity & Mobile-First Terminology
active_ledger.description: App officially rebranded to 'Reelio' (Tagline: Create. Realize. Reel.). All copy, messages, and guides must reflect mobile app context. All browser/extension/web-extension terminology is strictly banned.
anti_regression_guards: Do not mention 'المتصفح' or browser extension

active_ledger.title: Data Table Layout & Text Wrapping Prevention
active_ledger.description: All table columns must have explicit widths and whitespace-nowrap. Activation codes, dates, and plan durations (e.g. 'Pro Studio (5 يوماً)') must never wrap onto multiple lines. Action buttons must remain fully visible and never clipped.
anti_regression_guards: Enforce whitespace-nowrap on codes, dates, and badges
Wrap table in overflow-x-auto with min-w-[800px]

active_ledger.title: Modal Viewport Bounding & Sticky Action Footer
active_ledger.description: Modals must never extend beyond the viewport or hide action buttons. Constrain modal to max-h-[85vh] with flex flex-col, overflow-y-auto body, and sticky bottom footer containing confirm/cancel buttons.
anti_regression_guards: Action buttons must be fixed/sticky and 100% visible on all viewports
Body must scroll internally if content overflows

active_ledger.title: Icon and Visual Asset Rendering Integrity
active_ledger.description: All icons must be rendered as valid SVGs or Lucide icons. Raw ligature strings (e.g. 'content_copy') rendered as plain text are strictly prohibited.
anti_regression_guards: Ban raw icon ligature text in JSX/HTML

active_ledger.title: Customer Lookup & Device Intelligence Card
active_ledger.description: When activating by User ID or Phone, display an instant verified customer card showing name, phone, verified badge, device hardware (e.g. 'iPhone 15 Pro, iOS 18.1'), and active tier. Provide clear inline guidance for device ID lookup.
active_ledger.provenance: WhatsApp screenshots 2026-11-08 at 1.30.09 PM & 2026-11-10 at 3.24.49 PM
anti_regression_guards: Never show cryptic unexplained 'معرف الجهاز' input
Always render customer preview card upon valid ID/phone entry

active_ledger.title: Executive SaaS Dashboard & Dual Theme Architecture
active_ledger.description: Dashboard must match modern executive SaaS standards: Dark mode (Obsidian Navy #0B0F19/#1E293B) and Light mode, warm amber/gold accents (#FBBF24), Hero greeting banner with date range, KPI metric cards with progress bars and trend deltas, visual Donut chart of license status distribution, and System Health indicator banner.
active_ledger.provenance: Client White-Label reference screenshots 2026-11-10 at 3.38.33 PM - 3.39.04 PM & voice note
anti_regression_guards: Both Dark Mode and Light Mode must be supported seamlessly
KPI cards, Donut chart, and System Health status must be present

active_ledger.title: Administrator Profile, Security & Bilingual Localization
active_ledger.description: Dedicated Admin/Company Settings tab allowing the admin to view and edit profile info, email, password, company name, support channels, and switch interface language between Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR).
active_ledger.provenance: Client voice note & screenshot 2026-11-10 at 3.38.43 PM
anti_regression_guards: Admin settings must never be omitted or reduced to a lone logout button

active_ledger.title: WhatsApp Message Logs, Notes & Absent Tracking
active_ledger.description: Preserve operations sections: WhatsApp message history (delivery status, sent messages, direct wa.me chat links), Revenue & Notes, and Absent tracking.
anti_regression_guards: Do not remove WhatsApp logs or revenue notes sections across iterations

active_ledger.title: Flexible Activation Coupons & Message Generator
active_ledger.description: Vouchers renamed to discount coupons / activation vouchers. Support custom duration (in days, weeks, custom integer 1-3650 days). WhatsApp phone number binding is optional. Includes ready-to-send localized WhatsApp message template with direct wa.me link.
anti_regression_guards: Do not enforce minimum 30 days for vouchers
Phone number lock must remain strictly optional

active_ledger.title: Full Subscription Lifecycle Actions & Customer Association
active_ledger.description: Every subscription record must clearly show the customer name and avatar, and provide an action menu with Delete, Suspend, Resuspend, Upgrade Plan, and Renew Now options.
anti_regression_guards: Never show anonymous subscription rows without customer name
Must provide suspend, resuspend, and delete actions
